name: FAOSTAT - Crops & Production (QCL)
description: Crop production quantities and yield per hectare by country and crop type. Domain QCL (Production/Yields). Core input for cropland Footprint demand.
notes: SDMX-standard API; database code QCL for production. Also at https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data

name: FAOSTAT - Land Use (RL)
description: Land area by use type: arable land, permanent pasture, built-up. Domain RL (Land Use) or LC (Land Cover). Defines physical hectares per land type.
notes: Database code RL for land use, LC for land cover

name: FAOSTAT - Livestock (QA)
description: Livestock population counts for cattle, sheep, goats, equines, camels. Used to calculate metabolic requirements and grazing demand minus cultivated feed.
notes: Database code QA for live animals or QCL for livestock products

name: FAOSTAT - Trade (TCL)
description: Import/export volumes of agricultural commodities. Used to convert production-based Footprint to consumption-based Footprint (Footprint_consumption = Production + Imports - Exports).
notes: Database code TCL for detailed trade matrix

name: FAOSTAT - Population (OA)
description: National population by country and year. Denominator for all per-capita calculations (gha/person).
notes: Database code OA for population

name: FAO FRA - Forest Resources Assessment
description: Forest area by country, deforestation rates, and forest biomass stock. Defines physical hectares of forest and timber regrowth capacity for the forest product Footprint.
notes: Download global/regional summary spreadsheets or individual country reports

name: FAO FishSTAT - Capture Fisheries
description: Marine and freshwater fish catch by species, country, and year. Includes by-catch. Used to calculate fishing ground Footprint demand against maximum sustainable yield.
notes: Capture Fisheries and Aquaculture Production datasets. FAO maximum sustainable yield reference: 93 million tons/year

name: IEA - CO2 Emissions from Energy
description: CO2 emissions from fossil fuel combustion by country, fuel type, and sector. Core input for the carbon Footprint component (65% of emissions after ocean absorption).
notes: API restricted to Enterprise licensees. Navigate to .Stat Data Explorer > Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Energy database. Free explorer available for browsing.

name: IEA - Energy Balances
description: Total primary energy supply by fuel type (coal, oil, gas, nuclear). Used to derive carbon intensity per fuel and total fossil energy demand.
notes: Nuclear energy counted at par with fossil fuel in Footprint accounts per Wackernagel et al. 2002

name: IPCC - National GHG Inventory Guidelines
description: Forest carbon sequestration rates by biome (26 biomes), CO2 emission factors per fuel type. Used to convert CO2 emissions into forest area needed for sequestration.
notes: Revised 1996 IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories: Workbook Volume 2. Also IPCC AR5/AR6 for updated sequestration science.

name: UN Comtrade - Merchandise Trade
description: Detailed bilateral trade flows by commodity (HS classification). Supplements FAO trade data for non-agricultural goods to compute consumption-based Footprint.
notes: Free registration: 100,000 records/call, 500 calls/day. Use Annual frequency, HS (Harmonized System) classification.

name: UN Population Division - World Population Prospects
description: Official national population estimates and projections by year. Reference denominator for per-capita Footprint and biocapacity.
notes: Downloadable Data Files section for annual estimates by country

name: GAEZ - Global Agro-Ecological Zones
description: Agricultural suitability indices (SI) per land type. Used to compute Equivalence Factors (EF = SI_landtype / SI_global_average) and inform Yield Factors across countries.
notes: Joint FAO/IIASA model. Theme 4: Suitability and Attainable Yield; Theme 5: Actual Yields and Production. Available as ArcGIS Image Services.

name: GLASOD - Global Soil Degradation
description: Maps of human-induced soil degradation classified as strong or extreme (unreclaimable). Used to reduce biocapacity estimates where land is permanently degraded.
notes: Digital GLASOD database from ISRIC. Download Shapefile format. Degradation rated as light/moderate/strong/extreme.

name: JRC GHSL - Global Human Settlement Layer
description: Satellite-derived built-up surface area grids at global scale. Provides more accurate built-up land estimates than low-resolution alternatives.
notes: Products: GHS-BUILT-S (built-up surface grids), EMC-BUILT (exposure mapping). Also on Google Earth Engine under tag 'ghsl'.

name: CORINE Land Cover
description: European land cover classification at 25ha resolution. Used for detailed built-up land and land-use-change tracking in European countries.
notes: Select year (e.g. CLC 2018), download vector/raster. European coverage only.

name: GTAP Database - Global Trade Analysis Project
description: Multi-Regional Input-Output tables linking economic sectors across countries. Used to construct Consumption-Land-Use Matrices (CLUM) allocating Footprint to final consumption categories.
notes: GTAP 12 (latest) or GTAP 10 (version used by Global Footprint Network). Covers ~80 countries. Licensed database from Purdue University.

name: Sea Around Us - Fisheries Trophic Data
description: Primary Production Requirement (PPR) per species and trophic level data. Converts fish catch tonnage into the biocapacity of fishing grounds needed to sustain that catch.
notes: Advanced Search > filter by EEZ for Tonnage/Value and PPR. Based on Pauly et al. methodology for fishing down food webs.

name: UNECE - Temperate and Boreal Forest Resource Assessment
description: Growth rates and standing stock for temperate and boreal forests. Complements IPCC tropical data to estimate global average forest sequestration capacity.
notes: Temperate and Boreal Forest Resource Assessment 2000 (UNECE/FAO). Used alongside IPCC tropical growth rates.

name: Global Footprint Network - National Footprint and Biocapacity Accounts
description: Pre-computed national Ecological Footprint and biocapacity results for ~194 countries from 1961 to present. Uses ~15,000 data points per country per year from all above sources.
notes: 2019 edition covers data through 2016. Now co-maintained with York University (Toronto). Public data explorer available; full dataset licensed.

name: FAO GLEAM - Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model
description: Detailed metabolic coefficients for maintenance, activity, and production (meat/milk) across livestock species and regional production systems. Estimates energy redirected through feed into animal outputs. Core input for separating crop-based feed from pasture-based grazing.
notes: Model documentation and regionalized parameter tables. GLEAM 3.0 covers cattle, buffalo, sheep, goats, pigs, chickens. Provides dry-matter feed intake by source (pasture, crop, residue).

name: SAGE - Global Grassland NPP
description: Global gridded datasets for net primary production (NPP) and land use from Center for Sustainability and the Global Environment (SAGE), University of Wisconsin-Madison. World-average grass yield ~2.45 tonnes dry matter per hectare per year.
notes: Based on Monfreda et al. (2008). Also available through GAEZ/FAO gridded data. Provides above-ground edible NPP needed to convert livestock feed demand to grazing hectares.

name: FishBase - Trophic Level Data
description: Fractional trophic levels for over 35,000 fish species, ranging from 1.0 (algae) to 4.2+ (top predators like tuna). Required to compute Primary Production Requirement (PPR) per species for fishing ground Footprint.
notes: Search species > Biology > Trophic Ecology for ecology table. REST API available via rfishbase/fishbaseapi for batch queries.

name: Sea Around Us - PPR Parameters
description: Standardized parameters for transfer efficiency (10.13%) and wet-weight-to-carbon conversion ratio (9:1). Spatial catch data by EEZ. Used to convert fish catch tonnage into primary production required.
notes: API provides catch data by EEZ, LME, or High Seas. Advanced Search for tonnage and PPR by species group.

name: FAO SOFIA - State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture
description: Current assessments of sustainable vs. unsustainable fish stocks. Builds on historical Gulland (1971) reference of 93 million tonnes/year for global marine capture. Biennial report on fisheries status.
notes: Download biennial SOFIA reports. Key reference for maximum sustainable yield (MSY) and stock status by FAO fishing area.

name: GAEZ v4 - Suitability Indexes
description: FAO/IIASA Global Agro-Ecological Zones v4. Suitability indices (SI) and agro-ecological attainable yields for 53 crops based on soil, terrain, and climatic conditions. Required for time-varying EQF computation.
notes: Theme 4: Suitability and Attainable Yield. Download raw raster (.tif) or export attribute tables as .csv. Five suitability classes: VS(0.9), S(0.7), MS(0.5), mS(0.3), NS(0.1).

name: GFN Calculation Factors
description: Pre-computed world-average yields for grazing land, forest land, and fishing grounds used in the National Footprint and Biocapacity Accounts. Includes yield factors and equivalence factors by year.
notes: Free Public Data Package or Calculation Factors download upon license agreement at footprintnetwork.org/licenses/calculation-factors-free/.

name: UNECE/FAO TBFRA - Forest NAI
description: Net Annual Increment (NAI) for temperate and boreal forests. World average: 1.81 m3/ha/yr of harvestable wood. Used as denominator for forest product Footprint calculation.
notes: Temperate and Boreal Forest Resource Assessment 2000. Used with FAO GFSM (1998) tropical data. Complements IPCC tropical growth rates.

name: Khatiwala et al. 2009 - Ocean CO2 Uptake
description: Time-varying ocean CO2 uptake fraction (28-35% of anthropogenic emissions). Required to compute net CO2 needing terrestrial sequestration in the carbon Footprint formula.
notes: Published in Nature 2009. Time series of ocean CO2 sink (Pg C/yr). Divide by CDIAC total anthropogenic emissions for fraction. Alternative: use IPCC constant ~35%.

name: Mancini et al. - Forest Carbon Sequestration
description: Average Forest-Carbon Sequestration rate: 0.73 ± 0.37 t C/ha/yr for world-average forests. Distinguishes primary, secondary, and plantation forests. Includes fire, soil, and harvested wood product emissions.
notes: Published constant used from NFA 2016 onwards. Earlier accounts used IPCC rates across 26 biomes. Key denominator in carbon Footprint: EF_C = CO2 * (1 - S_Ocean) / Y_C * EQF_forest.
